full_judgment: Mohamamd Abdur Rouf, J.: Plaintiff-respondent on 23rd March, 1993 filed Title Suit No. 91 of 1993 in the Court of the learned Assistant Judge, First Court. Dhaka, a suit for permanent injunction for restraining his full brother, the defendant-petitioner herein, from dispossessing him from 5 kathas of land on the eastern side out of 10 kathas of C.S. Plot No. 7, khatian No. 206, Mouza Dhanmondi. Dhaka asserting his exclusive possession therein and asserting further that on 18.3.93 the petitioner threatened to dispossess him there from. The plain-tiff claims the suit land by way of inheritance from his father on the basis of a compromise decree dated 9.2.78 passed in partition Suit No. 23 of 1978 by the Court of Subordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Dhaka.
